profiles.preparation: Catalog only; no solver input or invented runtime.
profiles.validation: Links, provenance and classification.
profiles.real_city_blocker: Not an executable capability.

requirements.admission_condition: CRS and IDs explicit with source edition and category coverage reviewed

profiles.preparation: Select area, preserve source IDs, project only with declared operation, map fields and retain provenance.
profiles.validation: Geometry validity, dimensions, IDs, bounds, CRS/units and required attributes.
profiles.real_city_blocker: Coverage and domain attributes are not guaranteed by a map.

requirements.admission_condition: band meaning, nodata and resolution explicit

profiles.preparation: Subset/window, harmonize grids only through recorded resampling; preserve original metadata.
profiles.validation: CRS, affine transform, bands, nodata, coverage, units and resolution.
profiles.real_city_blocker: An available raster can be unsuitable for the intended analysis.

profiles.preparation: Use typed queries and bounded artifacts; preserve IDs and revision.
profiles.validation: Role/scope, CRS, geometry column, counts and query limits.
profiles.real_city_blocker: An instance and authorized data are required.

requirements.admission_condition: direction topology and cost definition with source supporting declared travel mode

profiles.preparation: Build graph with native tool, preserve graph/source version, project and specify routing profile.
profiles.validation: Connectivity, direction, intersection semantics, units and source coverage.
profiles.real_city_blocker: Mapped roads do not imply capacity, reliable speed, pedestrian completeness or traffic demand.

requirements.admission_condition: seed, time and vehicle types fixed

profiles.preparation: Convert network with SUMO tools, prepare demand separately, resolve relative file references and preserve assumptions.
profiles.validation: Network-route consistency, edge IDs, units, time coverage, vehicle counts and configuration.
profiles.real_city_blocker: OSM cannot supply calibrated OD demand or signal timings everywhere.

requirements.admission_condition: publisher rights, service dates and timezone
coordinate order and travel profile explicit

profiles.preparation: Validate feed, align graph/feed versions, build native graph and retain query date/timezone.
profiles.validation: GTFS validation, service calendar, stop/street linkage, CRS and transfer assumptions.
profiles.real_city_blocker: Feeds may be missing, expired or not include realtime information.

profiles.preparation: Align zone IDs/years and units; use upstream synthesis/choice model with declared seed and assumptions.
profiles.validation: Control totals, missingness, joins, weights and model diagnostics.
profiles.real_city_blocker: Population grids alone do not supply surveys, choice coefficients or OD demand.

profiles.preparation: Align IDs and travel-time definition; select thresholds/impedance without silent defaults.
profiles.validation: Matrix dimensions, reachable/unreachable coding, weights, time and denominators.
profiles.real_city_blocker: Travel-time generation and opportunity quality remain separate dependencies.

requirements.admission_condition: nodes, conduits, invert levels, sections, roughness and catchments

profiles.preparation: Parse/validate INP, check referenced series, use copies for alternatives and preserve declared units.
profiles.validation: Topology, conduit/node references, catchment coverage, rainfall interval, continuity and native diagnostics.
profiles.real_city_blocker: Street maps and global DEM do not provide a hydraulic drainage model or design rainfall.

requirements.admission_condition: topology, diameters, elevations, demands, pumps and controls

profiles.preparation: Preserve native network and parameter sets, separate hypothetical interventions and measurement provenance.
profiles.validation: Connectivity, hydraulic units, demand patterns, controls, solver status and mass/energy checks.
profiles.real_city_blocker: Pipe inventory, demand and operating controls normally require the utility/project owner.

requirements.admission_condition: terrain versus surface and vertical datum checked

profiles.preparation: Prepare using native tools/HydroMT, record resampling, grid, boundary conditions and coefficients.
profiles.validation: Vertical/horizontal CRS, resolution fitness, wet/dry references, timestep and mass balance.
profiles.real_city_blocker: Coarse surface products and reanalysis do not automatically support street-scale calibrated flood predictions.

profiles.preparation: Use upstream mesh/case preparation; document boundary mapping and selected solver module.
profiles.validation: Mesh quality, boundaries, datums, temporal alignment and reference-case diagnostics.
profiles.real_city_blocker: Global bathymetry is not a harbor survey; field forcing and calibration may be required.

profiles.preparation: Validate IFC, map only explicit properties, preserve GUIDs and express losses in any conversion.
profiles.validation: Schema version, units, geometry, references, georeferencing and required fields.
profiles.real_city_blocker: Public footprints do not provide building systems, materials or a valid IFC model.

profiles.preparation: Validate schema and references and retain comment/issue authorship and revision.
profiles.validation: Resolvable components, model version, geometry viewpoint units and permissions.
profiles.real_city_blocker: Issue data and model access are project-provided.

profiles.preparation: Open a separate document/session, apply native operations and preserve recompute/save semantics.
profiles.validation: Native reopen, object identity, dimensions, recompute status and version.
profiles.real_city_blocker: A geometric object is not a complete engineering/BIM model.

profiles.preparation: Load through native viewer/converter; map display IDs back to source artifacts.
profiles.validation: Scene bounds, CRS/transforms, units, selection identity and visual state.
profiles.real_city_blocker: A renderable scene may omit analysis semantics or source accuracy.

requirements.admission_condition: may be embedded in the building model

profiles.preparation: Use native translator and version transition only where supported; preserve schedules and simulation settings.
profiles.validation: Model schema/version, closed zones, units, weather coverage, HVAC/schedules and native error reports.
profiles.real_city_blocker: Footprints and EPW alone cannot determine a complete or calibrated energy model.

profiles.preparation: Use the selected UBEM generator; document archetype assignment and geometry-to-building mapping.
profiles.validation: IDs, building completeness, archetype assumptions, weather, units and aggregation.
profiles.real_city_blocker: Global building data does not supply local building physics or occupancy.

profiles.preparation: Translate formats explicitly; record timezone, resampling and observed/modelled/TMY distinction.
profiles.validation: Coverage, variable units, missing values, calendar and station/grid representativeness.
profiles.real_city_blocker: TMY and gridded reanalysis are not measurements of a chosen local event.

profiles.preparation: Prepare with native climate tools; harmonize geometry/forcing at an explicitly accepted resolution.
profiles.validation: Heights, roughness/materials, shading, temporal completeness, CRS and model-specific balances.
profiles.real_city_blocker: Heights, vegetation and local forcing may be unavailable; coarse global layers do not remove those requirements.

profiles.preparation: Keep upstream preprocessing and domain nesting; record forcing source and conversion chain.
profiles.validation: Domain boundaries, vertical levels, forcing completeness, timestep and reference diagnostics.
profiles.real_city_blocker: Surface ERA5-Land alone is not a full atmospheric initialization dataset.

profiles.preparation: Use upstream preprocessing, explicit speciation/temporalization and emission-grid mapping.
profiles.validation: Species, units, grids, meteorological coverage and mass/chemistry diagnostics.
profiles.real_city_blocker: Global emissions inventory is not automatically a street-level or model-ready local inventory.

requirements.admission_condition: scale, origin, CRS and acquisition metadata

profiles.preparation: Run native pipeline, subset without losing coordinate metadata and export artifact references.
profiles.validation: Point count, CRS, precision, classification, transform and known-geometry checks.
profiles.real_city_blocker: Local survey coverage and acquisition quality are project-specific.

profiles.preparation: Translate class schemes and grid definition explicitly; preserve metric definition.
profiles.validation: Class codes, nodata, pixel area, neighborhood, extent and reference metrics.
profiles.real_city_blocker: Landscape pattern does not automatically establish ecological function or observed biodiversity.

profiles.preparation: Select one upstream model, prepare its tables and layers and record assumptions.
profiles.validation: Each model input specification, coverage, units and reference outputs.
profiles.real_city_blocker: Coefficients, observations and local validation are not supplied by a generic global raster.

profiles.preparation: Join by stable IDs, preserve aggregation and specify estimation/permutation settings.
profiles.validation: Denominators, missingness, ID order, weights, units and diagnostics.
profiles.real_city_blocker: Aggregate/modelled grids do not establish individual behavior or causal effects.

profiles.preparation: Prepare native model tables/configuration and distinguish observed stock from scenario assumptions.
profiles.validation: Control totals, joins, IDs, calibration data, constraints and reference forecast.
profiles.real_city_blocker: Parcel attributes, market data and local coefficients cannot be inferred from map geometry alone.

profiles.preparation: Use platform API; keep drafts separate from submissions and link to scenario only when authorized.
profiles.validation: Process status, scope, identity, receipt and read-back.
profiles.real_city_blocker: There is no universal public write endpoint or permission to speak/vote for participants.

profiles.preparation: Query native API and translate only declared models; preserve timestamp/relationship semantics.
profiles.validation: Schema/context, IDs, scope, units, pagination and temporal ordering.
profiles.real_city_blocker: An endpoint, credentials and domain mapping may be required; protocols are not automatically equivalent.

requirements.admission_condition: topology impedance voltage bases and controls

profiles.preparation: Use native circuit/network model and solver; keep base and intervention separate.
profiles.validation: Units, connectivity, balance, convergence, feasible constraints and reference solution.
profiles.real_city_blocker: Mapped lines or buildings do not provide a calibrated electrical model.

profiles.preparation: Match hazard/exposure definitions and preserve event/revision links.
profiles.validation: Units, vulnerability domain, spatial/temporal alignment and reference impact.
profiles.real_city_blocker: Geometry alone cannot determine losses or locally valid vulnerability.

profiles.preparation: Use native noise model and explicit emission preparation; retain receiver IDs.
profiles.validation: Source units, frequency/period, geometry, receiver location and reference levels.
profiles.real_city_blocker: A road centerline is not a measured noise source or calibrated acoustic model.

requirements.admission_condition: bands, level, acquisition and cloud mask

profiles.preparation: Subset, normalize and georeference through the selected model pipeline; isolate GPU dependencies.
profiles.validation: Band order, scale, nodata/clouds, CRS, weights, split leakage and spatial output.
profiles.real_city_blocker: Available imagery is not ground truth; weights/data may have separate rights or access conditions.

profiles.preparation: Discover capabilities, filter, preserve item/asset versions and resolve authorized assets.
profiles.validation: Conformance, item IDs, geometry, datetime, asset availability and rights.
profiles.real_city_blocker: A catalog entry does not prove the asset is downloadable or fit for a model.

requirements.admission_condition: rules, seed, stop conditions and model version

profiles.preparation: Keep original model/rules, set reproducible seed and retain assumptions as scenario data.
profiles.validation: Agent counts, constraints, seed, stop condition and reference trajectory/statistics.
profiles.real_city_blocker: A framework does not supply validated human behavior; LLM agents may also require external providers and budget.

profiles.preparation: Use maintained validator and explicit profile, report unresolved references.
profiles.validation: Schema version, reference resolution, units and semantic requirements where defined.
profiles.real_city_blocker: Schema validity is not scientific validity or evidence that a backend implements every operation.

requirements.admission_condition: schema, CRS, vertical units, IDs and LoD

profiles.preparation: Use original importer/exporter, retain semantic surfaces and identifiers, record conversion losses.
profiles.validation: Schema, coordinates, topology, LoD, IDs, relationships and native validation.
profiles.real_city_blocker: Open footprints do not constitute a complete CityGML/CityJSON model.

profiles.preparation: Align sources and use native reconstruction tools; label reconstructed versus observed attributes.
profiles.validation: Alignment, point/classification quality, units, watertightness and comparison against control geometry.
profiles.real_city_blocker: Incomplete heights/footprints and low-resolution elevation can prevent suitable reconstruction.

profiles.preparation: Use native mesher/solver tools; separate geometry preparation from physical case validation.
profiles.validation: Boundary completeness, mesh metrics, dimensions, timestep, residuals and conservation/reference fields.
profiles.real_city_blocker: A display scene or OSM model does not provide a valid CFD mesh or calibrated conditions.

profiles.preparation: Use the native CKAN/GeoNetwork/GeoNode API; resolve resource links and access terms before ingestion.
profiles.validation: API version, pagination, resource IDs, license, format and link availability.
profiles.real_city_blocker: Metadata does not imply a usable downloadable dataset; no STAC conformance is assumed.

profiles.preparation: Discover native capabilities and select only supported operations; separate querying from administration.
profiles.validation: Advertised conformance, collection schema, CRS, filters, bounds and result links.
profiles.real_city_blocker: A configured endpoint and actual provider data are required; process support cannot be inferred.

requirements.admission_condition: scope, native object protocol and credentials

profiles.preparation: Preserve the native object graph, authorize the project and record serialization/conversion losses.
profiles.validation: Project scope, object IDs, versions, units, permissions and round trip.
profiles.real_city_blocker: A catalog protocol cannot substitute the native Speckle object/project contract.

profiles.preparation: Use native openEO client and backend jobs; validate graph against the configured backend.
profiles.validation: Backend capabilities, graph validity, bands, quotas, job status and result assets.
profiles.real_city_blocker: A process definition or STAC listing does not guarantee executable backend coverage.

requirements.admission_condition: measurement names, metadata schema and storage

profiles.preparation: Use native Data Cube index/API; align measurements and preserve xarray/grid metadata.
profiles.validation: Index health, product schema, storage links, units, nodata and coverage.
profiles.real_city_blocker: Unindexed STAC assets do not automatically form a Data Cube product.

requirements.admission_condition: surfaces, optical materials and scene units

profiles.preparation: Use native Radiance/Honeybee recipe and preserve sensor IDs and execution parameters.
profiles.validation: Scene geometry, material definitions, sky, sensor orientation and known light result.
profiles.real_city_blocker: A footprint or HVAC model is not a complete daylight scene.

profiles.preparation: Use the selected hydrological model/plugin; record basin delineation, parameters and forcing conversion.
profiles.validation: Basin topology, units, temporal completeness, water balance and calibration diagnostics.
profiles.real_city_blocker: A hydrological runoff model does not automatically produce street inundation depths.

requirements.admission_condition: costs, direction, capacity and zone connectors
zone IDs, modes, period and units

profiles.preparation: Use native network/matrix APIs; align zones and demand and retain congestion assumptions.
profiles.validation: OD/network consistency, demand totals, flows, cost units and convergence.
profiles.real_city_blocker: Mapped streets do not supply the OD matrix, capacities or observed congestion calibration.
